newsitem.title: USA: Natl City to boost stake in Natl Processing.
newsitem.headline: Natl City to boost stake in Natl Processing.

text.p: National City Corp said it plans to buy up to an additional two million more shares of National Processing Inc, increasing its stake to about 89 percent from its current stake of 85 percent.
There are currently 50,575,000 shares outstanding of National Processing, of which National City owns 43,100,000.

National Processing sold a stake of about 12 percent in its August 1996 initial public offering of 6.5 million shares. The shares were sold for $16.50 each. The stock closed on Thursday at $7 a share on the New York Stock Exchange.
